thread:
sam: Heads-up: planning a pilot rollout tonight — upgrading runtime kernel 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0 and switching quant profile to q8_fast for the test pool. Target window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Who can own smoke for their region?
alejandra: I can own smoke for eu-west. Do you want a short checklist or a script?
sam: Short script is below. TL;DR: health check, small gen (5 tokens), p99 < 250ms, verify kv-cache warm hits.
```
# smoke steps
curl -fS https://staging-eu.runtime.redwood/api/v1/health
curl -s -X POST https://staging-eu.runtime.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":5}' | jq '.latency_ms'
# check logs for kvcache: grep KV_WARMED /var/log/runtime.log
```
ben: I'll be the deploy owner for wave 1 (eu + qa). Planning to start image push at 22:00 UTC. Ping me when infra slots are confirmed green.
deploy-bot: rollout job #68421 created by ben, scheduled start 22:00 UTC. Will post status updates here.
ciro: Rollback plan: revert to image tag redwood/runtime:2.4.0 and quant_profile q8_std. Rollback command: `kubectl set image ds/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:2.4.0 -n runtime-prod` — infra runbook updated.
alejandra: quick Q: is q8_fast applied cluster-wide or just pool-B (test)? We should limit to pool-B first.
sam: Confirmed: pool-B only for pilot. We'll evaluate metrics for 30m before expanding.
lia: I'm on call tonight. If anything odd happens, @lia gets paged. Please set pager status to "deploy in progress" when you kick off.
ben: Noted. I'll post a short CSV of sample latencies when smoke finishes. Which dashboard are we watching?
sam: Watch runtime/rolling/latency (link: https://console.redwood/boards/runtime/rolling/latency). Filter: model=default, quant_profile=q8_fast. Also keep an eye on errors/api/5xx.
alejandra: Smoke done for eu-west: health ok, sample gen latencies: [195, 210, 220, 240, 205] ms. p99 ~240ms. No errors. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-deploy/rollouts/1834567890/smoke-eu.csv
ben: Starting deploy: step 1/4 image push -> rolling update begins.
deploy-bot: rollout #68421 step 1 complete — 25% hosts updated.
ben: Wave 1 (pool-B eu+qa) finished. All hosts updated, no errors, avg p95 = 200ms. Posting attached results in the deploy job metadata.
lia: Thanks — I'll watch for 30m. If anything spikes I'll escalate.
sam: If metrics stay green after 30m we schedule wave 2 (pool-A) at 23:15 UTC. Otherwise we rollback.
ben: Quick note: I'm keeping a tight window for rollback (15m) in case we see degraded tail latency.
ciro: Confirming rollback ownership and perms — I can trigger and monitor. Runbook step: `kubectl rollout undo ds/runtime -n runtime-prod --to-revision=2` and reapply quant_profile=q8_std.
alejandra: All good from eu. Will post a short summary in 30m.
sam: Thanks everyone. Checklist recap: @ben deploy, @alejandra smoke EU, @ciro rollback owner, @lia oncall/watch. Shout now if any conflicts. :thumbsup:
ben: All set, starting the job at 22:00. Will update here with a 1-line result when done.
